candidates.title: Adsorption energies and decomposition barrier heights for ethylene carbonate on the surface of lithium from cluster-based quantum chemistry.
candidates.abstract: For ethylene carbonate on the (100) surface of lithium, we calculate the adsorption energy in two binding motifs and the barrier height for a ring-opening decomposition reaction. We validate a scheme for producing results in the thermodynamic limit by correcting results obtained on finite lithium clusters containing only 40-100 atoms, which enables the use of hybrid density functionals, random-phase approximation, and correlated wavefunction theories, such as coupled-cluster theory and auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo. We find that the high-level theories agree to within 2-5 kcal/mol and can, therefore, serve as benchmarks for more affordable methods. Using our reference data, we demonstrate that generalized gradient approximation functionals, such as PBE, are not sufficiently accurate for reaction barrier heights, and we identify ωB97X-V as an especially promising functional for the interfacial chemistry of electrolyte solvents at lithium metal anodes.

candidates.abstract_ja: リチウムの表面(100)上の炭酸エチレンについて、2つの結合モチーフの吸着エネルギーとリング開閉分解反応の障壁高さを計算します。40〜100個原子のみを含む有限リチウムクラスターで得られた結果を補正することで熱力学極限で結果を導くスキームを検証し、これによりハイブリッド密度汎関数、ランダム位相近似、結合クラスター理論や補助場量子モンテカルロなどの相関波動関数理論の利用が可能になりました。高水準理論は2〜5 kcal/mol以内で一致し、より手頃な価格の手法のベンチマークとなり得ます。参照データを用いて、PBEのような一般勾配近似汎関数は反応障壁高度に対して十分に正確でないことを示し、リチウム金属陽極における電解質溶媒の界面化学において特に有望な関数としてωB97X-Vを特定しました。

candidates.title: EARTH-HCM: A Real-World Tool to Visualize the Burden of Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy in the United States.
candidates.abstract: BACKGROUND: There is limited evidence on geographical distribution of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) disease burden and a lack of visualization of national data for patient outcomes among patients with HCM. OBJECTIVES: To evaluate the feasibility of leveraging claims data to identify patients with HCM, estimate geographic disease burden, and integrate clinical and economic outcomes within a scalable visualization framework capable of supporting hypothesis generation and future outcomes research. METHODS: EARTH-HCM will be an open access, education tool to visualize patient characteristics, treatments, clinical outcomes, healthcare resource utilization, and costs for patients with HCM. This is a retrospective, observational study of longitudinal claims data from 2016 to 2023, with the first HCM diagnosis being considered the index date. RESULTS: Among 431,457 patients with a diagnosis for HCM, 166,081 (38.5%) patients had oHCM and 265,376 (61.5%) had nHCM. Among HCM patients, 51.1% were male with a mean age of 60.1 (17.7) years and median follow-up of 3.0 (2.4) years. Most patients were in age groups of 65+ (53.4%) and 55-64 (20.5%) and resided in the South (36.3%), followed by the Northeast (24.8%), Midwest (24.3%), and West (14.6%). CONCLUSIONS: EARTH-HCM demonstrates the feasibility of a national real-world surveillance framework to visualize the geographic distribution and healthcare burden of HCM and support future clinical and economic outcomes research.
candidates.title_ja: EARTH-HCM:米国における肥厚性心筋症の負担を可視化するための実例ツール。
candidates.abstract_ja: 背景:肥厚性心筋症(HCM)疾患負担の地理的分布に関する証拠は限られており、HCM患者の転帰に関する全国データの可視化が不足しています。目的:請求データを活用してHCM患者の特定、地理的疾患負担の推定、仮説生成および将来のアウトカム研究を支えるスケーラブルな可視化フレームワーク内で臨床および経済的アウトカムを統合する可能性を評価すること。方法:EARTH-HCMは、HCM患者の特徴、治療、臨床アウトカム、医療資源利用率、費用を可視化するためのオープンアクセスの教育ツールとなります。これは2016年から2023年までの縦断的請求データを遡及的かつ観察的に研究し、最初のHCM診断をインデックス日とみなします。結果:HCMと診断された431,457人の患者のうち、166,081人(38.5%)がoHCM、265,376人(61.5%)がnHCMでした。HCM患者のうち51.1%が男性で、平均年齢は60.1歳(17.7)歳、中央値追跡期間は3.0年(2.4)でした。患者の大半は65+歳(53.4%)および55-64歳(20.5%)の年齢層で、南部(36.3%)、次いで北東部(24.8%)、中西部(24.3%)、西部(14.6%)が続きました。結論:EARTH-HCMは、HCMの地理的分布と医療負担を可視化し、将来の臨床および経済的アウトカム研究を支援するための全国的な実世界監視フレームワークの実現可能性を示しています。

candidates.title: Comment on essd-2026-255
candidates.abstract: Abstract. High severity wildfires, driven by a complex interplay between climate change, vegetation growth, and human activity, present a critical threat to human safety and to the ecosystems of California. Forecasting and managing these fire systems is hindered in part by a lack of comprehensive, long-term, and regularly updated data regarding the vegetation fuel loads and forest structural conditions that drive fire behavior. To address this data need, we developed and launched the California Forest Observatory in the fall of 2020, which is a system designed to map forest structure and fuels at fine spatial and temporal scales. An extensive airborne LiDAR training dataset was integrated with multi-sensor satellite data from Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, and PlanetScope constellations. LiDAR-derived canopy fuel metrics — including canopy height, cover, base height, and ladder fuel density — were modeled using convolutional neural networks, which leveraged spatial context and sensor fusion to generate predictive models at 10-meter and 3-meter resolutions. Canopy bulk density and surface fuel data were estimated from process-based models. The canopy fuel models demonstrated strong performance: 10-meter model predictions ranged from r2 = 0.51 to r2 = 0.79, 3-meter performance metrics ranged from r2 = 0.72 to r2 = 0.79, with low net bias across all variables, outperforming comparable, recently-released data products. The output data have successfully supported wildfire hazard mapping, utility risk mitigation, and carbon neutrality planning across the state, and are available via PANGAEA (https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.989871). By providing a data-driven evidence base for monitoring vegetation change, the California Forest Observatory offers a blueprint for the next generation of satellite-based conservation technologies aiming to inform sustainable land management strategies.
candidates.title_ja: essd-2026-255の方法
candidates.abstract_ja: 要旨。気候変動、植生の成長、人間の活動が複雑に絡み合う要因によって発生する高強度の山火事は、カリフォルニアの人間の安全と生態系にとって重大な脅威となっています。これらの火災システムの予測と管理は、火災行動を引き起こす植生燃料負荷や森林構造条件に関する包括的で長期的かつ定期的に更新されるデータが不足していることが一因です。このデータニーズに対応するため、2020年秋にカリフォルニア森林観測所を開発し、これは森林構造と燃料を細かな空間的・時間的スケールでマッピングするシステムを設計しました。広範な空中LiDAR訓練データセットは、Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2、PlanetScope星座のマルチセンサー衛星データと統合されました。LiDAR由来のキャノピー燃料指標(樹冠の高さ、被覆、基底の高さ、はしご燃料密度など)は、空間コンテキストとセンサー融合を活用した畳み込みニューラルネットワークを用いてモデル化され、10メートルおよび3メートルの解像度で予測モデルを生成しました。キャノピーのバルク密度および表面燃料データはプロセスベースのモデルから推定されました。キャノピー燃料モデルは高い性能を示し、10メートルモデルの予測値はr2 = 0.51からr2 = 0.79の範囲、3メートル性能指標はr2 = 0.72からr2 = 0.79の範囲で、すべての変数で低い純バイアスで、最近公開された類似データ製品を上回っています。出力データは州全体で山火事災害マッピング、ユーティリティリスク軽減、カーボンニュートラル計画を支援しており、PANGEA(https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.989871)を通じて利用可能です。植生の変化を監視するためのデータ駆動型の証拠基盤を提供することで、カリフォルニア森林観測所は次世代の衛星ベースの保全技術の青写真を示し、持続可能な土地管理戦略の策定を目指しています。

candidates.title: Sodium depletion is associated with the response to glepaglutide in short bowel syndrome with chronic intestinal failure
candidates.abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Glepaglutide, a long-acting glucagon-like peptide 2 (GLP-2) analogue, reduces the need for parenteral support (PS) and increases nutrient absorption including sodium, in patients with short-bowel syndrome (SBS). We retrospectively studied the association between sodium homeostasis based on urine sodium levels and PS changes in response to glepaglutide for SBS chronic intestinal failure (SBS-CIF) patients. METHODS: The phase 3a EASE SBS-1 trial randomized 106 SBS patients with CIF (type III, according to the ESPEN classification) to receive glepaglutide 10 mg once (OW) or twice weekly (TW) vs. placebo for 24 weeks. We identified subgroups by sodium depletion, defined as a sodium concentration of <20 mmol/L or a sodium/potassium ratio of <1 in spot urine at baseline. Post-hoc subgroup analyses were performed using ANCOVA for the change in PS volume from baseline to week 24 (primary endpoint EASE SBS-1) and a logistic regression model for achieving the key secondary trial endpoint of clinical response (≥20 % reduction in PS volume from baseline to weeks 20 and 24). Groups receiving glepaglutide OW or TW were pooled in all analyses. We adjusted for sodium depletion, colon-in-continuity (CiC), treatment (active/placebo), and treatment-by-sodium depletion interaction. RESULTS: 42 % (22/52) of patients without CiC vs. 9 % (5/54) with CiC were sodium-depleted at baseline (p<0.0001). The overall prevalence of sodium depletion increased from baseline (25 %) to week 24 (36 %). Patients without sodium depletion (n = 79) had a significantly greater PS reduction with glepaglutide vs. placebo (p = 0.02). The nondepleted patients receiving glepaglutide were numerically more likely to achieve a clinical response in PS reduction (p = 0.12). Patients with sodium depletion at baseline had nonsignificant differences in PS reduction or clinical response (n = 27) and were likely to remain depleted at week 24 (n = 24, OR 13.5; p<0.0001). CONCLUSION: Sodium depletion is more common in SBS-CIF without CiC. This post-hoc analysis suggests that glepaglutide is more effective at reducing PS volume if sodium homeostasis is achieved before GLP-2 treatment begins.

candidates.title: A039 Biological significance of small extracellular vesicle remodeling in Huntington’s disease
candidates.abstract: In neurodegenerative diseases, extracellular vesicles (EVs) are often viewed as vehicles of toxic cargo that may promote pathobiology. However, a major function of EVs such as small EVs (SEVs) is to provide a platform for signalling between cells, and whether SEVs may be relevant to the regulation of intercellular communication between brain cells, such as neural cells and mature neurons, in the context of neurodegenerative diseases has remained largely unknown. To characterise the biological and molecular features of SEVs in the context of neurodegenerative diseases, such as Huntington’s disease (HD), we use models such as on-chip cortico-striatal connections derived from HD knock-in mice and human HD iPS cell-derived neural stem cells (NSCs) and neurons. Our results show how NSCs and neurons may remodel the release, function and protein composition of SEVs in response to HD. We will present the fundamental and translational implications of our findings. Funding ANR, France; Huntington’s Disease Foundation, USA; CHDI Foundation, USA

candidates.title: D021 Stage-dependent variability of endogenous fluid biomarkers and clinical measurements across HD-ISS stages in Huntington’s disease
candidates.abstract: Therapeutic trials in Huntington’s disease (HD) are increasingly reliant on fluid biomarker assays for accurate quantification of endogenous protein analytes used for target engagement, disease progression, and safety profiling. In particular, measurement of neurofilament light chain (NfL) and mutant huntingtin (mHTT) in HDClarity provides an opportunity to evaluate analytical rigor and biological reproducibility across matched CSF, plasma, and serum specimens within a deeply phenotyped cohort. Here, we investigated the performance of ultra-sensitive immunoassays for NfL, mHTT, and polyQ-independent HTT across these matrixes in a pre-selected cohort of 80 individuals with paired visits, in which healthy controls and people with HD were sampled 4–8 weeks apart. This narrow temporal window reduced the likelihood of clinical disease progression. Results showed high between-visit reproducibility for NfL and mHTT, whereas only NfL demonstrated strong concordance between CSF and blood; HTT analytes correlated poorly across matrices. Using imputed HD-ISS stages, we found that both NfL and mHTT increased in a stage-dependent manner, with NfL showing steepest rise in earlier stages. At the population level, both biomarkers showed associations with clinical measures including TMS, SDMT, and TFC, but individual values showed marked heterogeneity. The greatest spread was observed within HD-ISS stage 3. Within this stage, NfL aligned with disease burden measures including CAP and cUHDRS, whereas mHTT did not correlate with CAP score. These findings suggest that NfL may be the more reliable readout of HD disease burden and may help refine progression prediction within HD-ISS stage 3 when interpreted alongside TFC, cUHDRS, and CAP.

candidates.title: Safety of Nonsteroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drug Use in Traumatic Brain Injury.
candidates.abstract: BACKGROUND: Use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) after a traumatic brain injury (TBI) is controversial due to potential worsening of an intracranial hemorrhage (ICH). This study evaluated if NSAID use within 14 days of TBI was associated with a clinically significant progression of intracranial bleed (PIB). METHODS: A retrospective, propensity score-weighted study was conducted in adult patients with a TBI admitted to an American College of Surgeons Certified Level I Trauma Center. The NSAID group included patients who received at least one dose of an NSAID within 14 days of injury while admitted. The control group included patients who did not receive NSAIDs. The primary end point was incidence of a clinically significant PIB (decrease in the Glasgow Coma Score (GCS) > 2 and an increased or new ICH). Secondary outcomes included need for additional neurosurgical intervention and PIB on imaging regardless of GCS change. RESULTS: 978 patients were included: 284 in the NSAID group and 694 in the control group. Most patients had an Abbreviated Injury Score head > 2 (88%) and a subdural hematoma (57%). Fifty-two percent of patients had a mixed bleed. A clinically significant PIB occurred in 0.35% in the NSAID group and 1.2% in the control group (Hazards Ratio 0.1, 95% Confidence Interval 0.01-0.82, p = 0.032). There was no difference in additional neurosurgical operations or PIB regardless of GCS change. In the NSAID group, there was no significant difference in time from admission to NSAID administration between patients who experienced a PIB and those who did not have a PIB (1.9 days vs. 4.7 days, respectively, p = 0.06). CONCLUSION: In this single-center, retrospective, propensity score-weighted study, NSAIDs were not associated with an increased risk of clinically significant PIB in patients with acute TBI when administered within 14 days of injury. NSAIDs appear safe in the acute phase post-TBI. Prospective studies are needed to validate our results.

candidates.title: Nonpathogenic SIV Infection in Sooty Mangabeys Is Characterized by a Lack of Activation and Expansion of Monocytes.
candidates.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Natural hosts of simian immunodeficiency virus (SIV), including sooty mangabeys (SMs), maintain high viremia without progressing to AIDS and AIDS-associated histopathogenesis. The mechanisms underlying this protection and lack of pathogenesis remain incompletely understood, particularly in relation to monocyte/macrophage activation. METHODS: Plasma soluble CD163 (sCD163), monocyte CD163 expression, and monocyte subset phenotypes were quantified in uninfected and naturally SIV-infected SMs and compared with uninfected and SIV-infected rhesus macaques (RMs). Flow cytometry and multivariate analyses were used to assess monocyte activation and subset distribution. RESULTS: sCD163 levels and CD163 surface expression were increased in SIV-infected RMs but not SMs. SIV-infected SMs exhibited reduced CD14+CD16+ monocyte expansion and lower expression of CD64, MAC387, CD11b, and CCR2 compared with SIV-infected RMs. Machine learning identified CD14+CD16+CCR8+ monocytes as the top discriminator of SIV infection in SMs. CONCLUSION: These findings indicate a lack of monocyte activation in SMs that correlates with non-pathogenic infection.

candidates.title: Safety, tolerability, and efficacy of RIPK1 inhibitor, SAR443820, in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (HIMALAYA): a multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 2 trial.
candidates.abstract: BACKGROUND: RIPK1, a protein regulating inflammatory signalling and cell death, is implicated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) pathophysiology. SAR443820 is a selective, oral, CNS-penetrant, reversible RIPK1 inhibitor. We aimed to evaluate the safety, tolerability, and efficacy of SAR443820 in participants with ALS. METHODS: This multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 2 trial was conducted at 63 clinical sites in 13 countries (Belgium, Canada, China, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain, Sweden, the UK, and the USA). Adults (aged 18-80 years) with a diagnosis of possible ALS, clinically probable ALS, clinically probable laboratory-supported ALS, or clinically definite ALS, in accordance with the revised El Escorial World Federation of Neurology criteria, were randomly assigned (2:1) by use of a stratified block design (blocks of three) to receive either 20 mg SAR443820 orally twice per day or matching placebo in the 24-week double-blind period. Randomisation was done centrally using interactive response technology and stratified by geographical region of trial site, region of ALS onset, use of riluzole, use of edaravone, and use of the combination of sodium phenylbutyrate and taurursodiol. Participants, care providers, investigators, and outcomes assessors were masked to trial intervention. The primary outcome was a change in ALS Functional Rating Scale Revised (ALSFRS-R) total score from baseline to week 24 and was calculated for all participants who had an ALSFRS-R total score available at baseline and at week 24. Safety analyses included all randomly assigned participants receiving one dose or more of trial intervention. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05237284) and was terminated early. FINDINGS: Between April 13, 2022, and July 17, 2023, 397 participants were screened and 305 randomly assigned to SAR443820 (n=203) or placebo (n=102); six were excluded from the primary analysis due to missing baseline ALSFRS-R values. Mean age was 56·9 years (SD 11·5); 183 (60%) participants were male and 122 (40%) were female. Least squares mean change in ALSFRS-R from baseline to week 24 was -6·73 (95% CI -7·48 to -5·98) for SAR443820 group (n=169) and -6·32 (-7·36 to -5·27) for placebo group (n=87). There was no statistically significant difference between the study groups (least squares mean difference -0·41 [95% CI -1·71 to 0·88]). Participants in the SAR443820 group had higher incidence of adverse events (171 [85%] of 202 vs placebo 80 [78%] of 102) and treatment discontinuations (28 [14%] of 202 vs placebo five [5%] of 102), with elevated hepatic enzymes being the most common cause. Nine deaths occurred in the double-blind period (seven [3%] of 202 in the SAR443820 group and two [2%] of 102 in the placebo group); none was attributed to SAR443820. INTERPRETATION: SAR443820 did not show clinical benefit and was associated with higher hepatic enzyme increase, indicating that further clinical development of SAR443820 in ALS is not warranted. FUNDING: Sanofi.

candidates.title: UK Dementia Trials Network: an expert-informed framework for improving representation in dementia trials.
candidates.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is the leading cause of dementia worldwide, yet clinical trials remain unrepresentative of those most affected. Ethnic minoritized groups, socioeconomically deprived communities, adults over 75, and populations in low- and middle-income countries are consistently underrepresented, limiting generalizability and reinforcing health inequities. This white paper draws on an international roundtable on Diversity and Inclusion in Dementia Trials, convened by the UK Dementia Trials Network at the Alzheimer's Association International Conference 2025. We determined that key barriers to research participation included geographic distance, financial burden, restrictive eligibility criteria, invasive procedures, and limited study partner support. We also highlight gaps in ethnic diversity and the inadequate integration of sex and gender considerations in trial design and reporting. Improving representation in AD trials is both a scientific and moral imperative. Achieving this requires coordinated action across community engagement and trust building, data transparency and reporting, global trial access and capacity building, eligibility criteria reform, and financial and logistical support for participants. We propose an expert-informed implementation framework derived from the roundtable that identifies actionable strategies, responsible stakeholders, measurable indicators, and expected implementation outcomes to support translation of our recommendations into practice.

candidates.title: Comprehensive Clinical Evaluation Demonstrates Favorable Safety, Robust Neutralizing Antibody Responses, and Broad Population Immunogenicity to a Chikungunya Virus Virus-like Particle Vaccine (VIMKUNYA)
candidates.abstract: Abstract The chikungunya virus (CHIKV) virus-like particle (VLP) vaccine, VIMKUNYA ™ , has demonstrated favorable safety and immunogenicity throughout its clinical development program. Here, we present aggregated safety outcomes from 5 phase 2/3 trials and immunogenicity outcomes from 4 trials conducted at multiple US sites in healthy participants aged 12 to 95 years. Participants received a single intramuscular 40 µg dose of CHIKV VLP vaccine or placebo. Immunogenicity was assessed using serum neutralizing antibody (SNA) titers (NT 80 ), geometric mean titers (GMTs), and seroresponse rates at predefined timepoints. Preclinical nonhuman primate (NHP) data indicated that the regulatory clinical seroresponse threshold (NT 80 ≥100) is more conservative, approximately 4-fold higher than titers associated with sterilizing immunity, prompting exploratory analyses at additional thresholds: NT 80 ≥25.7 (associated with sterilizing immunity in NHPs) and NT 80 ≥15 (assay lower level of quantitation). This exploration of other relevant thresholds may provide valuable context for healthcare professionals and policy makers when evaluating immunization strategies. The CHIKV VLP vaccine elicited rapid and robust neutralizing antibody responses: 47% of recipients achieved NT 80 ≥100 at 7 days postvaccination (Day 8), rising to 96% at 2 weeks and 97% by 3 weeks postvaccination, with 85% maintaining seroresponse at 6 months (Day 183). At Day 8, 92% of participants achieved the NT 80 ≥15 assay threshold and 86% achieved the NHP NT 80 ≥25.7 biological threshold; at Day 183 these responses were maintained by 99% and 98%, respectively. Younger participants and females exhibited more rapid early responses and more sustained seroresponse at later timepoints, reflecting age- and sex- associated immunologic gradients. The vaccine was well-tolerated; most adverse events were mild or moderate, predominantly injection site pain, headache, fatigue, and myalgia. No vaccine-related safety signals or cases of CHIKV-like illness were identified. Older adults reported fewer solicited and unsolicited adverse events than younger age groups, and no treatment‑related serious adverse events observed, supporting a favorable safety profile across all age groups. Together, these findings demonstrate that a single dose of CHIKV VLP vaccine induces rapid, high-magnitude, and durable neutralizing immunity with a favorable safety profile, supporting its use in individuals aged ≥ 12 years and its suitability for broad public health implementation.

candidates.title: Holonic Bioprocess Units as Autonomous Cyber-Physical Modules for Distributed Biopharmaceutical Automation
candidates.abstract: Modular biomanufacturing requires process units that can be integrated and reconfigured without losing process constraints, quality boundaries, or traceability. ISA-95, ISA-88, and Module Type Package (MTP) provide established integration structures, while autonomous bioreactor initiatives demonstrate the value of process analytical technology (PAT), real-time analytics, and feedback control for individual unit operations. However, these approaches do not define how modular units can interpret process intent, assess their own capabilities, and adapt under explicit policies. This work-in-progress paper proposes artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled Holonic Bioprocess Units (HBPUs) that couple a physical bioprocess unit and deterministic control with an Asset Administration Shell (AAS) Type 3-inspired active digital twin acting as the HBPU agent. The active digital twin represents state, capabilities, constraints, data quality, and evidence requirements and uses this knowledge for intent interpretation, capability matching, and policy-constrained interaction. System-level orchestration and governance remain with agents that do not necessarily represent physical assets.

candidates.title: Image Analysis Tools for Continuous Label-free Quantification of Proliferation and Adipogenic Differentiation of Mesenchymal Stem Cells
candidates.abstract: Abstract Background Accurate quantification of mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and adipogenic differentiation is essential for applications ranging from metabolic disease research to cultivated fat production. However, conventional endpoint assays fail to capture the dynamics of these processes. Label-free live-cell imaging, combined with automated image analysis, enables continuous, non-invasive quantification over time. Methods Here, we present a comparative analysis of a device-integrated live-cell imaging analysis pipeline and custom-trained Cellpose segmentation models for label-free quantification of proliferation and adipogenic differentiation in human and porcine mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs). Results Both approaches enabled robust determination of cell number and confluence during proliferation. The device-integrated analysis showed higher accuracy at high confluence, whereas the custom-trained model achieved reliable single-cell segmentation at low to intermediate densities. During adipogenic differentiation, both methods successfully quantified adipocytes but differed in their segmentation strategies. The device-integrated analysis primarily detected contrast-rich regions associated with mature adipocytes, while the model segmented individual adipocytes, enabling quantification of both adipocyte area and number and allowing earlier detection of differentiation events. Custom-trained models demonstrated adaptability across species and imaging modalities, including manually acquired brightfield images. Conclusions Overall, label-free image analysis reduces experimental effort, avoids staining-related artefacts, and enables time-resolved characterization of cellular processes. While device-integrated analysis offers ease of use and seamless integration, Cellpose models provide superior flexibility and applicability, highlighting their complementary strengths for advanced cell culture analysis. All developed Cellpose models are publicly available.

candidates.title: Super-Res Tanager: A Deep Learning Based Sharpening Approach For Tanager Hyperspectral Images
candidates.abstract: Spaceborne hyperspectral imaging has evolved in the past 25 years, moving from research missions to the first commercial platforms. In August 2024, Tanager-1 was launched as the first in a constellation of satellites developed by Planet and NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory through the Carbon Mapper Coalition. Spaceborne hyperspectral systems allow repeated, precise mapping of atmospheric properties and surface characteristics at large-scale. However, in order to manage data volume, they often have a coarser spatial resolution compared to the high spectral resolution they achieve. Combining these sensors with higher spatial resolution monitoring systems through image fusion or pansharpening increases the value of these sensors for use cases where spatial detail matters. Under the Horizon Europe project MINEYE we are exploring the combination of Tanager and PlanetScope for mineral applications. We introduce a novel deep learning pipeline, which fuses 30 m Planet Tanager hyperspectral (HS) data with 10 m PlanetScope multispectral (MS) imagery. Our solution is the first specifically designed for this sensor pair and employs a two-stage approach: first, a robust multi-scale co-registration aligns the sensors, followed by a specialized dual-branch U-Net for 3x spatial enhancement. Critically, we move beyond synthetic data by training and validating the model on a large-scale, real-world dataset of 44 global Areas of Interest (AOIs) using Wald’s protocol. Validation results demonstrate high fidelity, achieving a Spectral Angle Mapper (SAM) of 1.99.
fields: IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS)

candidates.title: The first report of Si Bridge type 2.5D package's reliability for Automotive Applications
candidates.abstract: Demand for artificial intelligence (AI) in automotive application is growing. This leads to chiplet devices, and 2.5D/3.5D packages should be mandatory in automotive systems in the near future. AI would be used mainly in Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems (ADAS). Required reliability level of AECQ100 and AECQ104 is Grade 2. On the other hand, 2.5D and 3.5D packages’ structure has many layers of different materials which causes critical reliability risks. It is urgent to clarify the reliability potential of advanced packages in automotive applications. ASRA (Advanced SoC Research for Automotive) developed a mechanical test vehicle (MTV) of a Si bridge type 2.5D package to find out reliability risks in automotive use and its improvement plan. In this paper, we introduce our achievements in 3 parts, which are "Design concept", "Stiffener design DOE" and "Reliability results". In the 1st part, the design of Test Vehicle (TV) is introduced. The MTV mimics the structure of a chiplet that consists of two logic dies and two accelerator dies. The details of the 60mm x 60mm TV are given. In the 2nd part, stiffener Design Of Experiments (DOE) are investigated. Stiffener’s foot width, thickness and material are parameters of DOE. A thinner Cu stiffener does not have enough performance to control warpage. SUS stiffener has the smallest warpage variation during temperature change. In the 3rd part, the results of reliability tests are introduced. To optimize the material, we conducted preevaluation of two types of chip-on-wafer underfill resins. Temperature Cycle Test (TCT) based on AECQ100 and AECQ104 is carried out. The results are discussed with measured package warpage data.

materials.title: Phase II Study of Suratadenoturev (OBP-301) in Combination With Pembrolizumab in PD-L1-Negative or Immunotherapy-refractory Esophagogastric Adenocarcinoma
materials.title_ja: PD-L1陰性または免疫療法に抵抗性の食道性腺癌におけるスラタデノトレフ(OBP-301)とペムブロリズマブの併用による第II相試験
materials.abstract: The goal of this study is to learn about of the research study drug, telomelysin (OBP-301), in combination with pembrolizumab in advanced or metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) cancer. The main question it aims to answer is whether this combination is safe and effective in this type of cancer. Participants will receive 5 injections of OBP-301, approximately every 2 weeks. OBP-301 will be injected directly into the tumor during an esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD). At the same time as the injection, a tumor biopsy will be taken. Participants will also receive pembrolizumab infusions every 6 weeks until disease progression or for a maximum of two years. Pembrolizumab infusions will occur on different days than OBP-301 injections. This is a phase II study of suratadenoturev (OBP-301) with pembrolizumab in advanced or metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal adenocarcinoma that has progressed on at least 1 line of prior therapy for advanced disease. Patients must have received prior immunotherapy (anti PD-1 therapy). This study will examine the addition of OBP-301 with pembrolizumab patients who are refractory to first line immunotherapy. Patients will undergo intra-tumoral injection of OBP-301 followed 2-4 days later by the administration of pembrolizumab. The OBP-301 injection will then be repeated every two weeks for 4 planned treatments, and up to one additional optional treatment. Pembrolizumab will be administered every 6 weeks until disease progression. The primary endpoint is objective response rate, with the target response rate of 20%, to examine the hypothesis that OBP-301 can overcome checkpoint resistance. The expected response to continuing anti-PD-1 therapy in this patient population would anticipated to be \<5%. As a key secondary endpoint, the investigators will also examine duration of response and progression free survival. In a previous trial of OBP-301 and pembrolizumab in the third line setting, two patients who had a partial response are now off therapy and without evidence of disease, with a duration of response 33+ months and 20+ months. The third patient with a partial response has been on therapy for 15+ months. This trial utilizes a Simon's two-stage Minimax design. In the first stage of the trial, 13 patients will be accrued. If there are 0 responses in these 13 patients, the study will be stopped. Otherwise, 14 additional patients will be accrued for a total of 27 patients. Status: RECRUITING. Phase: PHASE2. Sponsor: Weill Medical College of Cornell University.
materials.abstract_ja: 本研究の目的は、進行性または転移性胃食道接合部(GEJ)におけるペムブロリズマブと併用した研究薬剤テロメリシン(OBP-301)について知ることです。主な疑問は、この組み合わせがこのタイプのがんにおいて安全かつ有効かどうかです。参加者は約2週間ごとにOBP-301の5回の注射を受けます。OBP-301は食道胃十二指腸鏡検査(EGD)中に腫瘍に直接注射されます。注射と同時に腫瘍生検も行われます。参加者はまた、病変進行までの6週間ごと、または最大2年間ペムブロリズマブの点滴を受けます。ペムブロリズマブの点滴はOBP-301注射とは異なる日に行われます。これは、進行性または転移性胃がん、胃食道接合部、または進行性疾患に対して進行治療が少なくとも1回経過している食道腺癌において、ペムブロリズマブを用いたsuratadenoturev(OBP-301)の第II相試験です。患者は過去に免疫療法(抗PD-1療法)を受けている必要があります。本研究では、1線免疫療法に抵抗性のあるペムブロリズマブ患者に対してOBP-301の追加を検討します。患者は腫瘍内注射でOBP-301を受け、その後2〜4日後にペムブロリズマブ投与を行います。その後、OBP-301注射は2週間ごとに繰り返し行われ、4回の予定治療と最大1回の追加選択治療を行います。ペムブロリズマブは病変進行まで6週間ごとに投与されます。主要評価項目は客観的反応率であり、目標反応率は20%で、OBP-301がチェックポイント耐性を克服できるという仮説を検証します。この患者集団における抗PD-1治療継続の期待反応率は<5%と予想されます。主要な副次評価項目として、研究員は反応期間および無進行生存期間も検討します。OBP-301とペムブロリズマブを第3ライン環境で比較した以前の試験では、部分的反応があった2名の患者は現在治療を停止し、疾患の証拠もなく、反応期間は33+ヶ月および20+ヶ月です。3人目の部分的反応患者は15+か月間治療を受けています。本試験はサイモンズ2段階のミニマックス設計を採用しています。試験の第1段階では13名の患者が登録されます。これら13名で反応が0の場合、研究は中止されます。それ以外の場合、さらに14名の患者が増え、合計27名となります。状況:募集中。フェーズ:フェーズ2。スポンサー:コーネル大学ワイル医科大学。

materials.title: A Phase II Trial of Autologous Ex Vivo Expanded Tumor-Infiltrating Lymphocyte (TIL) Therapy With Lifileucel After Failure of PD-1 Blockade in Kidney Cancer.
materials.title_ja: 腎臓がんにおけるPD-1遮断失敗後のリフィリュセルを用いた自家腫瘍浸潤リンパ球(TIL)治療の第II相試験。
materials.abstract: This study aims to evaluate autologous ex vivo expanded tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte therapy (lifileucel/LN-145) for kidney cancer after failure of PD-1 blockade. This is a Phase II single-arm trial of tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy in kidney cancer. Briefly, participants who meet eligibility criteria undergo surgical removal of a metastasis or primary tumor to provide material for generation of the TIL product in a lab, which involves growing and expanding the immune cells contained in the tumor before infusing the TIL product into the patient. Baseline evaluations occur before tumor harvest, and participants who proceed on study undergo tumor resection so tissue can be shipped to a manufacturing facility to create the autologous TIL product LN-145/lifileucel. The treatment plan includes 5 days of lymphodepleting chemotherapy before TIL infusion, using cyclophosphamide and fludarabine, followed by LN-145 infusion on Day 0 and IL-2 (aldesleukin) afterward. The study calendar includes post-treatment visits around Day 14, Day 28, Weeks 8, 12, and 18, then every 3 months starting at Month 6, with long-term follow-up by telephone continuing until study end or withdrawal, up to Month 36. Participants undergo screening and tumor resection to obtain tissue for manufacture of the TIL product. If treatment proceeds, participants receive lymphodepleting chemotherapy with cyclophosphamide and fludarabine, followed by LN-145 infusion and IL-2 (aldesleukin). Participants complete scheduled clinic-based assessments and longer-term follow-up, including telephone follow-up approximately every 3 months for up to about 3 years Status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING. Phase: PHASE2. Sponsor: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center.
materials.abstract_ja: 本研究は、PD-1遮断失敗後の腎臓がんに対する自己体外拡大腫瘍浸潤リンパ球療法(lifileucel/LN-145)を評価することを目的としています。これは腎臓がんにおける腫瘍浸潤リンパ球(TIL)療法の第II相単腕試験です。簡単に言うと、適格基準を満たす参加者は転移または原発腫瘍の外科的除去を受け、TIL産物の生成材料を提供します。これは腫瘍内の免疫細胞を増殖・増殖させてから患者に注入します。ベースライン評価は腫瘍収穫前に行われ、研究を進める参加者は腫瘍切除を受け、組織を製造施設に送って自家TIL製品LN-145/リフィルーセルを製造できるようにします。治療計画は、TIL注入前にシクロホスファミドとフルダラビンを用いるリンパ球除去化学療法を5日間行い、その後0日目にLN-145、その後IL-2(アルデスロイキン)を投与します。研究スケジュールは、治療後14日目、28日目、8週目、12週目、18週目頃の受診、6ヶ月目から3か月ごとに、さらに36か月目までの電話による長期フォローアップを継続します。参加者はスクリーニングと腫瘍切除を受け、TIL製品の製造用組織を取得します。治療が進行した場合、参加者はシクロホスファミドとフルダラビンによるリンパ球除去化学療法を受け、その後LN-145およびIL-2(アルデスロイキン)投与を受けます。参加者は予定されたクリニック評価と長期フォローアップを実施。電話フォローアップは約3か月ごとに約3年間行われます。ステータス:NOT_YET_RECRUITING。フェーズ:フェーズ2。スポンサー:ベス・イスラエル・ディーコネス医療センター。

materials.title: A Phase 2 Multicenter Study of Autologous Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocytes (TIL or LN-145) in Patients With Metastatic Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer
materials.abstract: This is a prospective, open-label, multi-cohort, non-randomized, multicenter phase 2 study evaluating LN-145 in patients with metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer LN-145 is a ready-to-infuse TIL therapy that utilizes an autologous TIL manufacturing process, as originally developed by the NCI and further optimized by Iovance for the treatment of patients with metastatic NSCLC. The cell transfer therapy used in this study involves patients receiving a non-myeloablative (NMA) lymphodepleting preparative regimen, followed by infusion of autologous TIL, then finally followed by the administration of IL-2. Status: RECRUITING. Phase: PHASE2. Sponsor: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc..

materials.title: Clinical Study to Assess Efficacy and Safety of LN-145/LN-145-S1 (Autologous Centrally Manufactured Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocytes) Across Multiple Tumor Types
materials.title_ja: 複数の腫瘍タイプにおけるLN-145/LN-145-S1(自己中心製造型腫瘍浸潤リンパ球)の有効性と安全性を評価する臨床試験
materials.abstract: This phase II trial studies how well autologous tumor infiltrating lymphocytes LN-145 (LN-145) or LN-145-S1 works in treating patients with ovarian cancer, triple negative breast cancer (TNBC), anaplastic thyroid cancer, osteosarcoma, or other bone and soft tissue sarcomas that do not respond to treatment (refractory) or that has come back (relapsed). LN-145 is made by collecting and growing specialized white blood cells (called T-cells) that are collected from the patient's tumor. LN-145-S1 is made using a modified process that chooses a specific portion of the T-cells. The T cells may specifically recognize, target, and kill the tumor cells. PRIMARY OBJECTIVE: I. To evaluate efficacy using objective response rate (ORR) using Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) version (v)1.1 in each cohort. SECONDARY OBJECTIVES: I. Determine the disease control rate (DCR) within and across cohorts. II. Determine the duration of response (DOR). III. Determine progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS). IV. Further characterize the safety profile of adoptive cell therapy with tumor infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL) across multiple tumor types. EXPLORATORY OBJECTIVES: I. Establish duration of tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) persistence. II. Compare the molecular and immunological features of tumors before and after TIL therapy. III. Prospectively evaluate the existing immunotherapy response criteria (immune-related \[ir\]RECIST) as the best response assessment tool for TIL therapy among a diverse group of solid tumors. IV. To investigate TIL attributes (CD8 percentage \[%\], CD27 and CD28 expression) and correlation with response to therapy. V. Assess tumor marker (CA-125) response in patients who produce this tumor marker. VI. To assess Health-Related Quality of Life (HRQOL). OUTLINE: Patients are assigned to 1 of 2 cohorts. THYROID CANCER COHORT: Patients receive cyclophosphamide intravenously (IV) over 2 hours on days -7 and -6, fludarabine IV over 15-30 minutes daily on days -5 to -1, autologous tumor infiltrating lymphocytes LN-145 IV over 45 minutes on day 0 and aldesleukin IV over 30 minutes on days 1-4 for up to 6 doses. ICI OVARIAN CANCER, OSTEOSARCOMA, Triple Negative Breast Cancer, or OTHER BONE AND SOFT TISSUE SARCOMAS COHORT: Within 2-4 weeks prior to surgery, patients receive a single dose of nivolumab IV over 30 minutes, followed by a single dose of ipilimumab IV over 30 minutes Patients receive cyclophosphamide IV over 2 hours on days -7 and -6, fludarabine IV over 15-30 minutes daily on days -5 to -1, LN-145-S1 IV over 45 minutes on day 0 and aldesleukin IV over 30 minutes on days 1-4 for up to 6 doses. Within 12 weeks after receiving LN-145-S1, patients receive nivolumab IV over 30 minutes every 4 weeks in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. For cohorts treated without immune checkpoint inhibitors, completion of treatment is defined as having received any volume of LN-145/LN-145-S1 infusion followed by at least 1 dose of adjuvant IL-2. For cohorts treated with TIL + ICI, completion of treatment will correspond to the last dose of nivolumab or IL2 (if the subject is deemed unsuitable to receive adjuvant nivolumab). Patients are followed up at 18 weeks, 6, 9, 12, 18 and 24 months, then every 3 months for at least 3 years. Status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING. Phase: PHASE2. Sponsor: M.D. Anderson Cancer Center.
materials.abstract_ja: この第II相試験では、リンパ球に浸潤する自己腫瘍LN-145(LN-145)またはLN-145-S1が、卵巣がん、トリプルネガティブ乳がん(TNBC)、未形成甲状腺がん、骨肉腫、または治療に反応しない(難治性)または再発(再発)したその他の骨および軟部組織肉腫の患者に対する効果を調査します。LN-145は、患者の腫瘍から採取した特殊な白血球(T細胞)を採取・培養することで作られます。LN-145-S1は、T細胞の特定の部分を選択する修正プロセスで作られます。T細胞は腫瘍細胞を特異的に認識し、標的を絞り、殺すことがあります。主な目的:I.各コホートにおいて、Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors(RECIST)バージョン(v)1.1を用いて客観的応答率(ORR)を用いて有効性を評価すること。副次目的:I. コホート内およびコホート間での疾患制御率(DCR)を決定する。II. 応答期間(DOR)を決定する。III. 無進行生存期間(PFS)および全生存期間(OS)を決定する。IV. 複数の腫瘍タイプにわたる腫瘍浸潤リンパ球(TIL)を用いた養子系細胞療法の安全性プロファイルをさらに特徴付けること。探究的目的:I. 腫瘍浸潤リンパ球(TIL)の持続期間を確立すること。II. TIL治療前後における腫瘍の分子学的および免疫学的特徴を比較すること。III. 多様な固形腫瘍群におけるTIL療法の最良の反応評価ツールとして、既存の免疫療法反応基準(免疫関連\[ir\]RECIST)を前向きに評価すること。IV. TILの属性(CD8パーセント\[%\]、CD27およびCD28発現)および治療反応との相関を調査すること。V. この腫瘍マーカーを産生する患者の腫瘍マーカー(CA-125)反応を評価すること。VI. 健康関連生活の質(HRQOL)を評価すること。概要:患者は2つのコホートのいずれかに割り当てられる。甲状腺がんコホート:患者は7日目と-6日目に2時間かけて静脈内(IV)、第5日目から-1日目に1日目に1日15〜30分フルダラビン静脈注射、0日目に45分でLN-145静脈内、1日目から4日目に30分のアルデスロイキンIVを最大6回投与します。ICI卵巣がん、骨肉腫、トリプルネガネガティブ乳がん、またはその他の骨・軟部組織肉腫コホート:手術の2〜4週間前に、患者はニボルマブIVを30分間単回投与、その後イピリムマブIVを30分ずつ投与します。患者は第7日目および第6日目に2時間にわたりシクロホスファミドIVを、第5日目から第1日目にフルダラビンIVを1日15〜30分、0日目にLN-145-S1静脈内45分、アルデスロイキンIVを30分で最大6回投与します。LN-145-S1投与後12週間以内に、患者は4週間ごとに30分以上ニボルマブIVを投与し、進行や許容できない毒性がない場合に適用されます。免疫チェックポイント阻害薬を用いていないコホートでは、治療完了とはLN-145/LN-145-S1の任意の量の点滴を受け、その後少なくとも1回の補助剤IL-2投与を行ったことと定義されます。TIL + ICIで治療されたコホートでは、治療完了はニボルマブまたはIL2の最終投与量に対応します(被験者が補助剤ニボルマブ投与に不適切と判断された場合)。患者は18週、6週、9か月、12、18、24か月で追跡調査を行い、その後3か月ごとに少なくとも3年間継続します。状況:ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING。フェーズ:フェーズ2。スポンサー:M.D.アンダーソンがんセンター。

materials.title: Development of an effective direct qPCR method for cell therapy product quantification in non-clinical biodistribution studies.
materials.title_ja: 非臨床バイオディストリビューション研究における細胞治療製品定量のための効果的な直接qPCR法の開発。
materials.abstract: BACKGROUND: Evaluating the non-clinical biodistribution (BD) of cell therapy products (CTPs) is essential to predicting their efficacy and safety in clinical trials. Although BD is typically quantified by qPCR following DNA extraction, this process is labor-intensive and time-consuming, and subject to variability in extraction yield, which complicates normalization to organ weight or blood volume. In contrast, direct qPCR enables the quantification of lysed samples without DNA extraction. Here, we systematically developed an effective direct qPCR method applicable to BD studies of CTPs. METHODS: We used HLCN061, a genetically modified natural killer (NK) cell derived from human induced pluripotent stem (iPS) cells. Mouse organs and blood containing HLCN061 cells were lysed, diluted, and directly subjected to real-time PCR using a human-specific Alu primer set. PCR reactions employed an inhibitor-tolerant master mix. Assay performance was evaluated by linearity (R2), amplification efficiency, relative error (RE), coefficient of variation (CV), and lower limit of quantification (LLOQ). The validated method was then applied to evaluate the BD of HLCN061 cells over 24 h following intravenous administration to mice. RESULTS: Across all tissues and blood samples, R2 exceeded 0.99, PCR amplification efficiency ranged from 90% to 110%, and RE was within ±25%. CV values were within 25% except for one case. LLOQ was 0.25 cells/mg weight for the liver, lungs, kidneys, and heart; 1 cell/mg weight for the spleen and ovaries; and 0.3 cells/μL for blood. Weight-normalized concentrations were highest in the lung, with the most rapid clearance from blood. CONCLUSION: This direct qPCR method is effective and suitable for non-clinical BD assessment of CTPs.
materials.abstract_ja: 背景:細胞治療製品(CTP)の非臨床的生体分布(BD)評価は、臨床試験における有効性と安全性を予測するために不可欠です。BDは通常、DNA抽出後のqPCRで定量されますが、このプロセスは労力と時間がかかり、抽出率にばらつきが生じるため、臓器重量や血液量の正規化が複雑になります。これに対し、直接qPCRはDNA抽出なしで溶解サンプルの定量化を可能にします。ここでは、CTPのBD研究に適用可能な効果的な直接qPCR法を体系的に開発しました。方法:私たちは、ヒト誘導多能性幹細胞(iPS)から得られる遺伝子組み換え自然殺人細胞(NK)細胞HLCN061を使用しました。マウスの臓器およびHLCN061血液を溶解・希釈し、ヒト特有のアル・プライマーセットを用いてリアルタイムPCRに直接投与しました。PCR反応は阻害剤耐性マスターミックスを用いています。アッセイ性能は線形性(R2)、増幅効率、相対誤差(RE)、変動係数(CV)、定量下限(LLOQ)で評価されました。検証済みの方法を用いて、マウスへの静脈投与後24時間のHLCN061細胞のBD評価を行いました。結果:すべての組織および血液サンプルで、R2は0.99を超え、PCR増幅効率は90%から110%の範囲、REは±25%以内でした。CV値は1例を除き25%以内でした。LLOQは肝、肺、腎臓、心臓で0.25細胞/mg重量でした。脾臓および卵巣は1細胞/mg重量、血液は0.3細胞/μLでした。体重正規化濃度は肺で最も高く、血液からの除去が最も速かった。結論:この直接qPCR法は効果的であり、CTPの非臨床的BD評価に適している。
materials.summary: 検証済みの方法を用いて、マウスへの静脈投与後24時間のHLCN061細胞のBD評価を行いました。CV値は1例を除き25%以内でした。脾臓および卵巣は1細胞/mg重量、血液は0.3細胞/μLでした。

materials.title: Phase I/II Basket Trial: Boron Neutron Capture Therapy (BNCT) Using CICS-1 and SPM-011 for Patients With Recurrent Solid Malignant Thoracic Tumors That Are Unresectable and Perceived Challenging to Treat With Standard Treatment
materials.title_ja: 第I/II相バスケット試験:再発性の固形悪性胸部腫瘍患者に対するCICS-1およびSPM-011を用いたホウ素中性子捕獲療法(BNCT)。これらは切除不可能で標準治療では困難とみなされている患者
materials.abstract: To evaluate the safety and efficacy of Boron Neutron Capture Therapy (BNCT) in patients with recurrent thoracic solid tumors that are difficult to treat with standard radiation therapy or drug therapy and are unresectable. With "lung," "heart," "liver," "spinal cord," and "esophagus" as common risk organs in the treatment plan for BNCT using therapeutic CT to evaluate the safety and efficacy of BNCT in patients with unresectable and recurrent thoracic solid tumors which are difficult to treat with standard radiation and drug therapy. To evaluate the safety of ［18F］FBPA synthesized with MPS200FBPA. In addition, the usefulness of ［18F］FBPA-PET testing to determine the appropriateness of performing BNCT will be evaluated in an exploratory manner. Status: ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION. Phase: PHASE1, PHASE2. Sponsor: Stella Pharma Corporation.
materials.abstract_ja: 標準的な放射線治療や薬物療法では治療が困難で切除不可能な再発胸部固形腫瘍患者におけるホウ素中性子キャプチャー療法(BNCT)の安全性と有効性を評価すること。BNCT治療計画において「肺」「心臓」「肝臓」「脊髄」「食道」を一般的なリスク器官として扱い、治療用CTを用いて、標準的な放射線治療や薬物療法で治療が困難な再発性胸部固形腫瘍患者におけるBNCTの安全性と有効性を評価する。MPS200FBPAと合成された[18F]FBPAの安全性を評価すること。さらに、[18F]FBPA-PET検査によるBNCT実施の適切性を判断する有用性を探索的に評価する。ステータス:ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION。フェーズ:フェーズ1、フェーズ2。スポンサー:ステラファーマ・コーポレーション。

materials.title: Submacular Hemorrhage Requiring Procedural Intervention During Anti-VEGF Therapy for Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration in Japan: The JTY Three-Center Real-World Incidence Study
materials.title_ja: 日本における新生血管加齢性黄斑変性に対する抗VEGF治療中に手技的介入を必要とする黄斑下出血:JTY三施設実世界発生率研究
materials.abstract: PURPOSE: To estimate the incidence and clinical characteristics of submacular hemorrhage (SMH) requiring procedural intervention during anti-VEGF therapy for neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD) in a Japanese multicenter real-world setting, with exploratory comparison according to the preceding anti-VEGF agent. METHODS: This multicenter retrospective real-world incidence study reviewed surgical records from three Japanese centers to identify SMH requiring gas injection or vitrectomy during ongoing anti-VEGF treatment. The denominator was the total number of anti-VEGF injections for nAMD during the same period. Incidence per 1,000 injections and site-adjusted incidence rate ratios (IRRs) were estimated using quasi-Poisson regression. RESULTS: Among 47,358 injections, 54 SMH events requiring procedural intervention were identified (1.14 per 1,000 injections). Median final BCVA after procedural treatment was 1.00 logMAR (Snellen equivalent, 20/200), compared with 0.46 logMAR before SMH (approximately 20/60). PCV accounted for 39 events (72.2%), and prior SMH was documented in 12 eyes (22.2%). Crude incidence was 2.20 for ranibizumab, 1.09 for brolucizumab, 1.08 for aflibercept, and 0.24 for faricimab. Using aflibercept as the reference, IRRs were 1.83 for ranibizumab (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.73-4.59; P = 0.195), 0.91 for brolucizumab (95% CI, 0.25-3.28; P = 0.883), and 0.20 for faricimab (95% CI, 0.01-3.16; P = 0.251). CONCLUSIONS: SMH requiring procedural intervention during anti-VEGF therapy for nAMD was uncommon but visually severe; among affected eyes, PCV accounted for 72.2% of events. Exploratory drug-specific analyses did not demonstrate significant adjusted differences among anti-VEGF agents. Future patient-level studies should evaluate subtype-specific incidence, hemorrhagic recurrence, and polyp-directed treatment strategies in PCV-rich populations.
materials.abstract_ja: 目的:日本の多施設実世界における新生血管性加齢黄斑変性(nAMD)に対する抗VEGF治療中に手技的介入を必要とする黄斑下出血(SMH)の発生率および臨床的特徴を推定し、前述の抗VEGF薬剤による探索的比較を行うこと。方法:本研究は、3つの日本の医療機関の手術記録をレビューし、進行中の抗VEGF治療中にガス注射または硝子体切除を必要とするSMHを特定した。分母は同時期におけるnAMDに対する抗VEGF注射の総回数であった。準ポアソン回帰を用いて1,000回あたりの発生率および部位調整発生率(IRR)を推定した。結果:47,358回の注射のうち、54件のSMHイベントが手技的介入を必要とした(1,000回あたり1.14件)を特定した。処置後の最終BCVA中央値は1.00 logMAR(スネレン相当20/200)で、SMH前のlogMARは0.46(約20/60)でした。PCVは39件(72.2%)の事象を担当し、12眼でSMHが記録されていました(22.2%)。粗発生率はラニビズマブ2.20、ブロルシズマブ1.09、アフリベセプト1.08、ファリシマブ0.24でした。アフリバーセプトを基準としたところ、ラニビズマブのIRRは1.83(95%信頼区間[CI]、0.73-4.59;P = 0.195)、ブロルシズマブは0.91(95%CI、0.25-3.28)、P = 0.883)、ファリシマブでは0.20(95%信頼区間、0.01-3.16;P = 0.251)。結論:抗VEGF治療中に手技的介入を必要とするSMHはまれで、視覚的に重度でした。影響を受けた眼では、PCVが72.2%の事象を説明しました。探索的薬剤特異的解析では、抗VEGF薬剤間で有意な調整差は認められませんでした。今後の患者レベルの研究では、PCVが豊富な集団におけるサブタイプ特異的発生率、出血性再発、ポリープ主導の治療戦略を評価するべきです。

materials.abstract: Recent advancements in haemophilia treatment have dramatically reduced the frequency of symptomatic bleeding. However, there is a possibility that minor, asymptomatic bleeding may contribute to the progression of joint damage and diminish quality of life. Detecting small amounts of blood with minimal flow is difficult using existing testing methods, necessitating the development of new diagnostic approaches.

materials.title: Construction of QSRR model for reversed phase chromatography of steroid compounds based on quantum chemical calculation.
materials.title_ja: 量子化学計算に基づくステロイド化合物の逆相クロマトグラフィーQSRRモデルの構築。
materials.abstract: Steroid compounds widely exist in traditional Chinese medicines, food, and are often illegally added to cosmetics. Their residues and abuse pose serious threats to public health and raise critical issues in drug safety and quality control. Therefore, developing efficient and accurate qualitative identification methods is essential. Although UHPLC-HRMS is currently the most common identification method, it has limitations such as time-consuming optimization of chromatographic conditions, high costs of reference standards, incomplete databases, and difficulties in distinguishing isomers. Thus, there is an urgent need for effective retention behavior prediction methods to assist qualitative analysis. Quantitative structure-retention relationship (QSRR) models enable theoretical prediction of chromatographic retention times. However, most traditional models rely directly on density functional theory (DFT) for conformational optimization, resulting in low computational efficiency. This study proposes a two-step approach: first, rapidly screen stable preferred conformations using the (parametric method 6) PM6 semi-empirical method; then, calculate molecular descriptors via DFT. Using only 11 model compounds and two molecular descriptors, we developed a QSRR model that effectively predicts the retention times of steroid compounds. The model was externally validated using five steroid compounds including a pair of isomers, yielding a predictive determination coefficient Q2ext of 0.9618, with all relative errors below 4% and a mean absolute relative error (MARE) of 1.22%, demonstrating good predictive ability for unknown steroid compounds. This method improves computational efficiency, overcomes traditional modeling limitations, supports steroid isomer discrimination and qualitative identification, and provides insights into the reversed-phase separation mechanisms of structural analogs and separation optimization.
materials.abstract_ja: ステロイド化合物は伝統的な中国医学や食品に広く存在し、しばしば化粧品に違法に添加されています。その残留物や乱用は公衆衛生に深刻な脅威をもたらし、医薬品の安全性や品質管理において重要な問題を引き起こしています。したがって、効率的かつ正確な定性識別手法の開発が不可欠です。UHPLC-HRMSは現在最も一般的な同定手法ですが、クロマトグラフィー条件の最適化に時間がかかること、参照標準のコストが高く、データベースが不完全で、異性体の識別が困難であるなどの制約があります。したがって、定性的分析を支援する効果的な保持挙動予測手法が緊急に求められています。定量的構造-保持関係(QSRR)モデルは、クロマトグラフィー保持時間の理論的予測を可能にします。しかし、従来のモデルの多くは密度汎関数理論(DFT)に直接依存して立体構造最適化を行い、計算効率が低い結果となっています。本研究は2段階のアプローチを提案します。まず、(パラメトリック手法6)PM6半経験的手法を用いて安定した好ましいコンフォメーションを迅速にスクリーニングし、次にDFTを用いて分子記述子を計算します。11種類のモデル化合物と2つの分子記述子のみを用いて、ステロイド化合物の保持時間を効果的に予測するQSRRモデルを開発しました。モデルは2つの異性体を含む5種類のステロイド化合物を用いて外部検証され、予測決定係数Q2extは0.9618、すべての相対誤差は4%未満、平均絶対相誤差(MARE)は1.22%で、未知のステロイド化合物に対する良好な予測能力を示しました。この手法は計算効率を向上させ、従来のモデリングの限界を克服し、ステロイド異性体識別と定性的同定を支援し、構造類似体の逆相分離メカニズムや分離最適化に関する洞察を提供します。
materials.summary: 本研究は2段階のアプローチを提案します。11種類のモデル化合物と2つの分子記述子のみを用いて、ステロイド化合物の保持時間を効果的に予測するQSRRモデルを開発しました。モデルは2つの異性体を含む5種類のステロイド化合物を用いて外部検証され、予測決定係数Q2extは0.9618、すべての相対誤差は4%未満、平均絶対相誤差(MARE)は1.22%で、未知のステロイド化合物に対する良好な予測能力を示しました。

materials.title: Data fusion of high-performance liquid chromatography and near-infrared spectroscopy with explainable machine learning for commercial origin authentication of Cimicifugae Rhizoma.
materials.title_ja: 高性能液体クロマトグラフィーと近赤外分光法と説明可能な機械学習によるCimicifugae Rhizomaの商業起源認証のためのデータ融合。
materials.abstract: Multi-instrument data fusion combined with explainable machine learning offers a powerful strategy for complex sample authentication, yet quantitative attribution of each analytical source's contribution remains an unresolved methodological challenge. This study presents a two-platform data fusion framework integrating high-performance liquid chromatography with ultraviolet detection (providing both untargeted chromatographic fingerprints and targeted phenolic acid markers) and near-infrared spectroscopy, and employs SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) TreeExplainer for quantitative source-level attribution under a standard fixed 440/110 train/test hold-out with strict data separation. Using 550 Cimicifugae Rhizoma samples from 11 Chinese provinces, we evaluated feature-level (dimensionally reduced concatenation), mid-level (43 features reduced by principal component analysis, PCA), and high-level (out-of-fold stacking) fusion strategies with Random Forest and XGBoost classifiers. Mid-level fusion with Random Forest achieved numerically perfect classification (0/110 errors; 95% CI 96.7-100%), but McNemar's test did not separate it from the best single-source baseline (2/110 errors, p = 0.500), whereas paired testing across 10 independent resampled splits did (mean difference +2.9 percentage points versus the chromatographic-fingerprint baseline, p = 0.0003). SHAP analysis quantified source contributions as chromatographic fingerprint 39.7%, targeted phenolic markers 26.2%, and near-infrared spectrum 34.0% (aggregating to 66.0% and 34.0% by platform); platform attribution was stable across 26 independent perturbations of seed, classifier, PCA dimensionality and training split (HPLC 65.6 ± 2.7%). The three targeted markers, constituting only 7.0% of features, contributed 26.2% of total importance (3.8-fold enrichment), with caffeic acid ranked first among all 43 features. PCA loading stability across data partitions was quantitatively confirmed via Hungarian algorithm matching (top-5 chromatographic principal components (PCs) mean |r| = 0.970; near-infrared PCs mean |r| > 0.999). PC loading back-mapping was less conclusive than the attribution itself: the highest-ranked chromatographic component loads on an unassigned early-eluting region rather than on the three targeted markers, and the near-infrared components carrying importance correspond to broad spectral-shape, O-H and C-H/O-H overtone variation rather than to phenolic-acid-specific bands; the cross-platform convergence supported by these data is therefore at the level of a bulk phenolic and matrix gradient, not of independent spectroscopic confirmation of the chromatographically identified markers. Because the three pharmacopoeial species of Cimicifugae Rhizoma segregate geographically and individual batches were not species-identified, species identity and province of collection are confounded; the discrimination modeled here is therefore a species-origin composite signal associated with province of collection, corresponding to the commercial consignments in which this multi-origin herbal drug is traded, and does not constitute proof of geographic causality. A systematic cross-comparison with six prior data fusion studies for botanical authentication contextualizes the methodological contributions, which are transferable to other multi-instrument analytical workflows.
materials.abstract_ja: マルチインストゥルメントデータ融合と説明可能な機械学習の組み合わせは、複雑なサンプル認証に強力な戦略を提供しますが、各分析源の貢献を定量的に帰属させることは依然として未解決の方法論的課題です。本研究は、高性能液体クロマトグラフィーと紫外線検出(非ターゲットクロマトグラフィー指紋およびターゲットフェノール酸マーカーの両方提供)、近赤外分光法を統合した2プラットフォームのデータ融合フレームワークを提示し、標準的な固定440/110のトレイン/テストホールドアウトと厳格なデータ分離の下で定量的なソースレベルの帰属を行うSHAP(SHapley Additive exPlanations)TreeExplainerを用います。中国11省の550個のCimicifugae Rhizomaサンプルを用いて、特徴レベル(次元削減連結)、中間レベル(主成分解析で43の特徴を縮小)、および高レベル(折りたたみ外のスタッキング)融合戦略をランダムフォレストおよびXGBoost分類器で評価しました。ランダムフォレストを用いた中間レベル融合は数値的に完璧な分類(誤差0/110、95%信頼区間96.7-100%)を達成しましたが、McNemarの検定は単一ソースの最良のベースライン(誤差2/110、p=0.500)から分離できませんでした。一方、10の独立した再サンプル分割によるペアテストは分離しました(クロマトグラフィー・フィンガープリントベースラインに対する平均差+2.9パーセントポイント、p=0.0003)。SHAP分析により、クロマトグラフィー指紋として供給源の寄与が定量化されました。39。 7%、ターゲットフェノールマーカー26.2%、近赤外スペクトル34.0%(プラットフォーム別で66.0%および34.0%の合計);プラットフォームの帰属はシード、分類器、PCA次元性、トレーニングスプリットの26の独立した摂動で安定していた(HPLC 65.6 ± 2.7%)。標的マーカーは特徴のわずか7.0%を占め、全重要度の26.2%(3.8倍濃縮)に寄与し、カフェイン酸は43の特徴すべてで1位にランクされた。データパーティション間でのPCA負荷安定性はハンガリーのアルゴリズムマッチングによって定量的に確認された(上位5つのクロマトグラフィー主成分(PC)平均 |r| = 0.970;近赤外PCは|r| > 0.999)。PC負荷バックマッピングは帰属自体よりも決定的ではありませんでした。最も上位のクロマトグラフィー成分は、3つの標的マーカーではなく未割り当ての早期溶出領域に負荷をかけ、重要性を持つ近赤外成分はフェノール酸特異的バンドではなく、広範なスペクトル形状、O-HおよびC-H/O-Hの倍音変動に対応しています。したがって、これらのデータが支持するクロスプラットフォーム収束は、クロマトグラフィーで同定されたマーカーの独立した分光的確認ではなく、バルクフェノールおよびマトリックス勾配のレベルにあります。Cimicifugae Rhizomaの3種薬草原は地理的に分離しており、個々のバッチは種同定されていなかったため、種の同一性と収集領域は混同されます。ここでモデル化されている識別は、収集地域に関連する種起源の複合シグナルであり、この多産地のハーブ薬が取引される商業的な出荷に対応しており、地理的因果関係の証明にはなりません。植物認証に関する過去6件のデータ融合研究との体系的なクロス比較により、方法論的貢献が文脈化され、他のマルチ機器解析ワークフローに応用可能です。

materials.title: Which penile cancer patients with metastasis in a sentinel node may be spared inguinal lymph node dissection without compromising oncological safety? Development of a low-risk selection model.
materials.title_ja: センチネルリンパ節に転移した陰茎がん患者で、腫瘍学的安全性を損なうことなく鼠径リンパ節郭清を免れることができる患者はどれでしょうか?低リスク選択モデルの開発。
materials.abstract: PURPOSE: To develop and internally validate a low-risk selection model to guide omission of completion inguinal lymph node dissection (ILND) after a positive dynamic sentinel node biopsy (DSNB) and to identify predictors of an inguinal basin harboring additional inguinal lymph node metastases following a positive DSNB. METHODS: Data were drawn from the Danish National Penile Cancer Database (DaPeCa-data), comprising patients with penile cancer treated from 2000 to 2025. The analysis included 300 DSNB-positive inguinal basins, and each basin was analyzed independently. Candidate predictors were screened using a penalized logistic regression across multiple imputed datasets, with variables meeting a pre-specified selection threshold carried forward to a confirmatory multivariable model. An exhaustive search across combinations of clinical criteria was used to derive low-risk selection models, subject to a pre-specified safety constraint of a negative predictive value (NPV) ≥ 0.92. RESULTS: Among 300 DSNB-positive basins, 188 underwent ILND, of which 33 (18%) had additional nodal metastases. Metastasis size ≥ 10 mm, having more than one positive lymph node at DSNB, and bilateral positive DSNB were the strongest independent predictors of additional metastases after a positive DSNB. A two-criterion model (metastasis size ≤ 10 mm and no urethral invasion) spared 63 out of 248 evaluable basins (25.4%) from ILND, with 5 false-negative cases equal to an NPV of 0.921. A stricter three-criterion model spared 21 out of 248 basins (8.5%) with 1 false negative and an NPV of 0.952. Sensitivity analysis restricted to directly observed outcomes lowered the higher-yield model's NPV to 0.908. CONCLUSIONS: In penile cancer patients with a positive DSNB, the strongest predictors of the presence of additional inguinal lymph node metastases were: sentinel node metastases of 10 mm or more; two or more positive sentinel lymph nodes and bilateral sentinel lymph node metastases. A simple, bedside-usable selection model may safely spare a meaningful subset of DSNB-positive patients from completion ILND, but the prediction performance was sensitive to outcome-imputation assumptions and requires external validation before clinical implementation.
materials.abstract_ja: 目的:陽性動的センチネルリンパ節生検(DSNB)後の完了鼠径リンパ節解離(ILND)の回避を導く低リスク選択モデルの開発および内部検証、および陽性DSNB後に追加の鼠径リンパ節転移が存在する鼠径盆の予測因子を特定すること。方法:データは2000年から2025年に治療された陰茎がん患者を含むデンマーク国立陰茎がんデータベース(DaPeCa-data)から取得した。分析には300のDSNB陽性鼠径盆腔が含まれ、各盆地を独立して解析した。候補予測変数は複数の補帰データセットにわたるペナルティ化されたロジスティック回帰を用いてスクリーニングされ、事前指定された選択閾値を満たす変数は確認的多変数モデルに引き継がれた。臨床基準の組み合わせにわたる包括的な検索を用いて、陰性中率(NPV)≥0.92という事前定めされた安全性制約のもと、低リスク選択モデルを導出した。結果:300のDSNB陽性盆地のうち188がILNDを受け、そのうち33(18%)が追加のリンパ節転移を有していた。転移大≥10mm、DSNBに複数の陽性リンパ節、および両側陽性DSNBが陽性DSNB後の追加転移の最も強い独立予測因子であった。2つの基準モデル(転移サイズ≤10mmかつ尿道浸潤なし)では、248の評価盆地のうち63(25.4%)がILNDから免除され、偽陰性症例はNPVが0.921であった。より厳格な3基準モデルでは、248盆のうち21盆(8.5%)で偽陰性が1件、NPVは0.952でした。直接観察アウトカムに限定された感度解析では、高収量モデルのNPVは0.908に低下しました。結論:DSNB陽性の陰茎がん患者において、追加の鼠径リンパ節転移の最も強い予測因子は以下の通りです:10mm以上のセンチネルリンパ節転移;2つ以上の陽性センチネルリンパ節および両側センチネルリンパ節転移。シンプルでベッドサイドで利用可能な選択モデルは、DSNB陽性患者の有意な部分をILNDの完了から安全に回避できるかもしれませんが、予測性能はアウトカムインピテーションの仮定に敏感であり、臨床実装前に外部検証が必要です。
materials.summary: 結果:300のDSNB陽性盆地のうち188がILNDを受け、そのうち33(18%)が追加のリンパ節転移を有していた。転移大≥10mm、DSNBに複数の陽性リンパ節、および両側陽性DSNBが陽性DSNB後の追加転移の最も強い独立予測因子であった。結論:DSNB陽性の陰茎がん患者において、追加の鼠径リンパ節転移の最も強い予測因子は以下の通りです:10mm以上のセンチネルリンパ節転移;2つ以上の陽性センチネルリンパ節および両側センチネルリンパ節転移。

materials.title: Chronic ethanol exposure alters the expression of genes associated with GPCR-related signaling in the olfactory bulb of male mice.
materials.title_ja: 慢性的なエタノール曝露は、オスマウスの嗅球におけるGPCR関連シグナル伝達に関連する遺伝子の発現を変化させます。
materials.abstract: Chronic ethanol exposure, a key feature of alcohol use disorder (AUD), can affect the nervous system, but its molecular impact on the olfactory bulb remains unclear. In this study, an intermittent two-bottle voluntary drinking model was established in male mice, and transcriptome sequencing was performed on olfactory bulb tissues. DESeq2 analysis identified 188 differentially expressed genes, including 68 upregulated and 120 downregulated genes. Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) and Reactome pathway database (Reactome) analyses indicated that ethanol-responsive genes were predominantly enriched in receptor-mediated signaling pathways, particularly those linked to G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) signaling. Protein-protein interaction analysis further identified eight core GPCR-related genes. Quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) validation revealed that Cxcl10, Grp, Pcp2, and Pdyn were markedly downregulated in the ethanol group. These results suggest that chronic ethanol exposure is associated with transcriptional alterations in the male mouse olfactory bulb and may selectively affect several GPCR-related signaling components. This study provides candidate molecular evidence for further investigation of ethanol-associated olfactory dysfunction.
materials.abstract_ja: 慢性的なエタノール曝露はアルコール使用障害(AUD)の重要な特徴であり、神経系に影響を与える可能性がありますが、その分子レベルで嗅球への影響は依然として不明です。本研究では、オスマウスを対象に断続的な2本ボトルの自主飲酒モデルを確立し、嗅球組織に対してトランスクリプトームシーケンスを実施しました。DESeq2解析では188の差異発現遺伝子が特定され、うち68はアップレギュレーション、120はダウンレギュレーションされました。京都遺伝子・ゲノム百科事典(KEGG)およびリアクトーム経路データベース(Reactome)解析によると、エタノール応答性遺伝子は主に受容体介質シグナル伝達経路、特にGタンパク質結合受容体(GPCR)シグナル伝達に関連する経路に濃縮されていることが示されました。タンパク質間相互作用解析ではさらに8つのコアGPCR関連遺伝子が特定されました。定量的リアルタイムPCR(qRT-PCR)検証により、エタノール基ではCxcl10、Grp、Pcp2、Pdynが著しくダウンレギュレーションされていることが明らかになりました。これらの結果は、慢性的なエタノール曝露がオスのマウス嗅球における転写変化と関連し、複数のGPCR関連シグナル伝達成分に選択的影響を与える可能性を示唆しています。本研究は、エタノール関連嗅覚機能障害のさらなる研究のための候補分子証拠を提供します。
materials.summary: DESeq2解析では188の差異発現遺伝子が特定され、うち68はアップレギュレーション、120はダウンレギュレーションされました。タンパク質間相互作用解析ではさらに8つのコアGPCR関連遺伝子が特定されました。定量的リアルタイムPCR(qRT-PCR)検証により、エタノール基ではCxcl10、Grp、Pcp2、Pdynが著しくダウンレギュレーションされていることが明らかになりました。

materials.title: Complications after sentinel node biopsy and inguinal lymph node dissection in penile cancer: a Danish national cohort study.
materials.title_ja: 陰茎癌におけるセンチネルリンパ節生検および鼠径リンパ節郭清後の合併症：デンマーク全国コホート研究。
materials.abstract: PURPOSE: Sentinel node biopsy (SNB) and inguinal lymph node dissection (ILND) are central to penile cancer management, but ILND especially carries substantial morbidity. This nationwide study explores the extent and risk factors of postoperative complications after inguinal lymph node surgery in Danish penile cancer patients. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of penile cancer patients diagnosed in Denmark 2013-2025. Surgical procedures, pathological outcomes, and complications were extracted from medical records. Univariable and multivariable logistic regression with multiple imputation was used to assess predictors of complications. RESULTS: Among 745 patients, 717 underwent 1348 SNB procedures and 184 underwent 241 ILND procedures. Postoperative morbidity increased substantially with procedural extent, with complications occurring after 9% of SNB procedures and after 31% of ILND procedures. Lymphoedema developed in 47% of patients following ILND versus 9% following SNB. Increasing lymph node yield independently predicted overall complications within both SNB and ILND cohorts and was additionally associated with wound infection following SNB. For lymphoedema, ILND carried five- to nine-fold higher odds compared with SNB, while higher BMI independently predicted lymphoedema risk (OR 1.07 per kg/m2, p = 0.002). CONCLUSION: Complications increase markedly with procedure extent. Increasing lymph node yield was associated with wound infection, while lymphoedema is primarily determined by procedure type. Poor predictive ability of patient characteristics limits pre-operative risk stratification.
materials.abstract_ja: 目的: センチネルリンパ節生検 (SNB) と鼠径リンパ節郭清 (ILND) は陰茎癌の治療の中心ですが、特に ILND は重大な合併症を伴います。この全国規模の研究では、デンマークの陰茎癌患者における鼠径リンパ節手術後の術後合併症の範囲とリスク因子を調査します。方法: 2013～2025 年にデンマークで診断された陰茎癌患者の後向きコホート研究を実施しました。手術手順、病理学的結果、および合併症は医療記録から抽出されました。合併症の予測因子を評価するために、多重代入法を用いた単変量および多変量ロジスティック回帰を使用しました。結果: 745 人の患者のうち、717 人が 1348 件の SNB 手術を受け、184 人が 241 件の ILND 手術を受けました。術後合併症は手術範囲の拡大に伴い大幅に増加し、SNB手術では9%、ILND手術では31%で合併症が発生した。リンパ浮腫はILND手術後に47%の患者で発生したのに対し、SNB手術後には9%であった。リンパ節採取数の増加はSNBおよびILNDコホートの両方において全体的な合併症を独立して予測し、さらにSNB手術後の創感染とも関連していた。リンパ浮腫に関しては、ILND手術はSNB手術と比較して5～9倍高いオッズを示し、BMIが高いほどリンパ浮腫のリスクが独立して予測された（OR 1.07/kg/m2、p = 0.002）。結論：合併症は手術範囲の拡大に伴い著しく増加する。リンパ節採取数の増加は創感染と関連していたが、リンパ浮腫は主に手術の種類によって決定される。患者特性の予測能力が低いため、術前リスク層別化が制限される。
materials.summary: 結果:745人の患者のうち、717人が1348件のSNB手術を受け、184人が241件のILND手術を受けました。術後合併症は手術範囲の拡大に伴い大幅に増加し、SNB手術では9%、ILND手術では31%で合併症が発生した。リンパ浮腫はILND手術後に47%の患者で発生したのに対し、SNB手術後には9%であった。

materials.title: A Phase I/II Study of Endocardial Delivery for Myocardial Regeneration Using Human Induced Pluripotent Stem (iPS) Cell-derived Cardiomyocyte Spheroids for Heart Failure Reduced Ejection Fraction
materials.title_ja: 心不全の駆出率低下のためのヒト誘導多能性幹(iPS)細胞由来心筋球体を用いた心内膜内投与の第I/II相試験
materials.abstract: The purpose of this clinical study is to evaluate the safety and efficacy of endocardial delivery of HS-001 CS into severe heart failure patients with reduced ejection fraction for 26 weeks after transplantation. This is a multicenter, open-label, phase I/II study in 14 severe heart failure patients with reduced ejection fraction. After screening period is completed, subjects undergo HS-001 CS transplantation by endocardial delivery. After transplantation, subjects take immunosuppressant and have efficacy/safety assessments. Status: RECRUITING. Phase: PHASE1, PHASE2. Sponsor: Heartseed Inc..
materials.abstract_ja: 本臨床試験の目的は、移植後26週間、駆出率低下の重症心不全患者に対してHS-001 CSの心内投与の安全性と有効性を評価することです。これは、駆出率低下の重度心不全患者14名を対象とした多施設オープンラベルのI/II相試験です。スクリーニング期間終了後、被験者は心内投与によるHS-001 CS移植を受けます。移植後、被験者は免疫抑制剤を服用し、有効性・安全性評価を受けます。状況:募集中。フェーズ:フェーズ1、フェーズ2。スポンサー:Heartseed Inc.

materials.title: A Phase I/II Study of Human Induced Pluripotent Stem (iPS) Cell-derived Cardiomyocyte Spheroids (HS-001) in Patients With Severe Heart Failure, Secondary to Ischemic Heart Disease
materials.title_ja: 虚血性心疾患に二次的な重度心不全患者を対象としたヒト誘導多能性幹細胞(iPS)細胞由来心筋球体(HS-001)の第I/II相試験
materials.abstract: The purpose of this clinical study is to evaluate the safety and efficacy of HS-001 CS transplanted into severe heart failure patients with underlying ischemic heart disease for 26 weeks after transplantation. This is a multicenter, open-label, two-group dose-escalation, phase I/II study in 10 severe heart failure patients (five in the low-dose group and five in the high-dose group) with underlying ischemic heart disease. After screening period is completed, subjects undergo HS-001 CS transplantation. After transplantation, subjects take immunosuppressant and have efficacy/safety assessments. Status: COMPLETED. Phase: PHASE1, PHASE2. Sponsor: Heartseed Inc..
materials.abstract_ja: 本臨床試験の目的は、基礎欠血性心疾患を持つ重度心不全患者に移植後26週間、HS-001 CSの安全性と有効性を評価することです。本試験は、基礎性虚血性心疾患を持つ重症心不全患者10名(低用量群5名、高用量群5名)を対象とした多施設・オープンラベル2群投与増量第I/II相試験です。スクリーニング期間終了後、被験者はHS-001 CS移植を受けます。移植後、被験者は免疫抑制剤を服用し、有効性・安全性評価を受けます。ステータス:完了。フェーズ1、フェーズ2。スポンサー:Heartseed Inc.

materials.title: Organic Electrodes With Excellent Rate Capability and Cycling Stability Enabled by Assembling Active Materials onto Conductive Agents.
materials.title_ja: 活性材料を導電性剤に組み込むことで、優れた速度性能とサイクル安定性を持つ有機電極。
materials.abstract: Organic redox compounds represent a class of alternative electrode materials for lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) that are free of transition metals and completely biodegradable, with high molecular tunability, environmental benignity, and economic affordability. However, to realize this promise in practical devices, organic electrode materials (OEMs) must overcome low rate capability and poor cycling stability stemming from their intrinsically low electronic conductivity and pronounced solubility in organic solvents. Herein, we demonstrate an integrated strategy of embedding OEMs within conductive networks to simultaneously resolve these challenges. Using lithium terephthalate (LTP) as a model system, we assembled it on the conductive agent Super P (SP), the resulting composite delivers an impressive capacity of 104 mAh g-1 at a demanding 5C rate and retains 130 mAh g-1 after 1000 cycles at 1C, significantly outperforming its physically mixed counterpart, which delivers merely 25 mAh g-1 at 5C and rapidly fades to 56 mAh g-1 under identical cycling conditions. These exceptional electrochemical properties originate from the intimate interaction between the active LTP and the conductive SP network, which not only creates robust electronic pathways to access the potential capacities but also effectively prevents LTP dissolution in electrolytes during prolonged cycling.
materials.abstract_ja: 有機酸化還元化合物は、遷移金属を含まず完全に生分解性を持ち、高い分子調和性、環境的無害性、経済的手頃な価格を持つリチウムイオン電池(LIB)用の代替電極材料の一群です。しかし、この可能性を実用的なデバイスで実現するためには、有機電極材料(OEM)は、本質的に低い電子伝導率と有機溶媒における顕著な溶解性に起因する低回転率能力とサイクル安定性の低下を克服しなければなりません。本件では、導電性ネットワーク内にOEMを組み込む統合戦略を示し、これらの課題を同時に解決します。テレフタレートリチウム(LTP)をモデルシステムとして用い、導電性剤Super P(SP)上で組み立てました。その結果、5Cの要求的なレートで104mAhのg-1という印象的な容量を発揮し、1°Cで1000サイクル後も130mAhのG-1を保持し、物理的に混合されたもの(5°Cでわずか25mAhのG-1を供給し、同一サイクル条件下で急速に56mAhのG-1にフェードアウトする)を大きく上回っています。これらの卓越した電気化学的特性は、アクティブLTPと導電性SPネットワークの密接な相互作用に由来し、潜在能力にアクセスするための堅牢な電子経路を生み出すだけでなく、長時間のサイクル中に電解質中のLTP溶解を効果的に防いでいます。

materials.title: Mapping the Molecular Universe.
materials.title_ja: 分子宇宙のマッピング。
materials.abstract: The success of large-language-models highlighted the importance of datasets, whose quantity, quality, and diversity dictate the accuracy and creativity of artificial intelligence (AI) systems in learning and inferring. However, in scientific domains, such datasets required for domain-specific AI/machine-learning (ML) models do not exist most of the time. In this perspective, by examining the logics and rationales behind the construction and mapping of a universe for small organic molecules (108-1012), we explore what new capabilities AI can bring to the materials discoveries. We identify the elusive structure-property relationship as a core challenge for new materials design and explore the possibility AI tools could enable us to design based on targeted properties instead of the structural derivation. In a broader context, we further discuss what challenges and limitations AI-driven material sciences still face and envision possible avenues into the future of AI4Materials.
materials.abstract_ja: 大規模言語モデルの成功は、量、質、多様性が学習や推論における人工知能(AI)システムの正確性と創造性を決定づけるデータセットの重要性を浮き彫りにしました。しかし、科学分野では、ドメイン特有のAI/機械学習(ML)モデルに必要なこのようなデータセットはほとんど存在しません。この視点から、小型有機分子の宇宙を構築しマッピングする論理と理論(108-1012)を検証し、AIが材料発見にどのような新たな能力をもたらすかを探ります。新材料設計における捉えどころのない構造と特性の関係を核心的な課題として特定し、AIツールが構造導出ではなくターゲット特性に基づく設計を可能にする可能性を探ります。より広い文脈で、AI駆動材料科学が依然として直面する課題や制約についてさらに議論し、AI4Materialsの未来への可能な道筋を描いています。
